chk_dates.name: chk_dates
chk_dates.value: end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= allocation_date

chk_admin_scope.name: chk_admin_scope
chk_admin_scope.value:
(
      access_level = 'super'
      AND hostel_id IS NULL
      AND company_id IS NULL
    )
    OR
    (
      access_level IN ('regular', 'support')
      AND hostel_id IS NOT NULL
      AND company_id IS NOT NULL
    )
